correctness.rationale: The closed beta-binomial law, two-leaf pivotal identity, positive integrated moments and strictly decreasing affine ratio L(n) prove every quantifier: all d>=2, 1<=r<=d, alpha,beta>0, every pair and vaccinated subset. The 1260 exact-rational finite parameter checks independently verify but do not replace the unrestricted proof. r=1 and r=d boundaries are handled separately. The exact fixed-mean correlation reversal was recomputed.

value.rationale: This is a complete analytic phase diagram for a naturally specified overflow-risk vaccination response, identifying an exact correlation-induced loss of diminishing returns at fixed mean outbreak severity for any degree and overload level. It clarifies a meaningful distinction between linear expected infections prevented and non-linear probability of an overload. With exchangeable leaves, within-star dose placement is trivial; its value is characterization of coverage-dose curvature and heterogeneity effects, not a claimed new nontrivial allocation algorithm or clinical prediction.
